provenance.notes: Coefficients are magnitudes signed toward the opposite pole (direction_sign(task, target) * alpha). Baseline seed = 42 + 1000 + row; steered seed = 42 + int(sha256('eval200|{setup}|{model_id}|{task}|{layer}|{alpha}|{candidate_id}')[:8],16) % 1e6 (greedy, so inert). Judge input: `repsteer merge-steered` over the style, language, concept steer tables of this setup (production layer-major order), dealt round-robin to 64 shards (num_shards 64), flip=(k+job)%2. Invalid judgements are repaired once with the strict suffix (seed 910000+ordinal, 2048 new tokens). Aggregate with `repsteer aggregate --dataset catdog`.
provenance.split_recipe: vector/evaluation cells carved by scripts/replication prepare_steering_eval200_split.py port: per (language, style, concept) cell, sample(frac=1, random_state=seed+cell_index) then take 32 vector + 25 eval rows; seed 42; verified byte-equal to production results-gemma4-steering-eval200-split. Production geometry (this config's geometry block) ran on the FULL 1041-row pool with n_per_cell 50 and auto-reduce, not on a post-split remainder; run `repsteer geometry` with the corpus path directly to mirror it. The geometry block's n_per_cell=50 + auto_reduce_n_per_cell=true mirrors --n_per_cell 50 --auto_reduce_n_per_cell from pbs_gemma4_geometry_hsmean_stride3_zscore.sh; audit_n_per_cell=40 mirrors the eval-disjoint matched audit (run on `repsteer eval-disjoint` output).
